groups.name: single
groups.command: mpirun --allow-run-as-root -x PCCL_GDR_CPU_FLUSH=1 -x PCCL_CPU_FLUSH_ASYNC=1 -x NCCL_IB_ADAPTIVE_ROUTING=1 -x NCCL_IB_OOO_RQ=1 -np {ranks} -npernode {npernode} -mca btl_tcp_if_include {mpi_interface} -mca btl ^openib -mca btl_openib_warn_no_device_params_found 0 -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -x NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=ALLOC,PROFILE {operation} -t 1 -g 1 -d half -b 8 -e 16G -f 2 -n 20 -w 5 --elapsed_type 1

groups.name: nodes2
groups.command: mpirun --allow-run-as-root -x PCCL_GDR_CPU_FLUSH=1 -x PCCL_CPU_FLUSH_ASYNC=1 -x NCCL_IB_ADAPTIVE_ROUTING=1 -x NCCL_IB_OOO_RQ=1 -np {ranks} -npernode {npernode} -x PATH={path} -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH={ld_library_path} --hostfile {hostfile} -mca btl_tcp_if_include {mpi_interface} -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO {operation} -b 8 -e 16G -f 2 -g 1 -t 1 --elapsed_type 1
